guide.quickAddTitle: Quick add: get the pre-set shortcut
guide.quickAddSubtitle: Installs Log Transaction with Amount, Merchant & Card already wired — you still make the automation.

steps.1: Open the Kachingz app once after installing (this registers the action)
steps.2: Open Shortcuts → Automation. On iOS 27: tap ‹ until you reach Library, then Automation → +. On iOS 26: the Automation tab → New Automation
steps.3: If you see "Describe a shortcut", tap Edit → in the search sheet tap Automation → under Apps choose Wallet ("When I tap a Wallet Card or Pass"). Leave Any Card, Any Category and Any Merchant
steps.4: On iOS 26: leave every card and category selected → Run Immediately → Next → New Blank Automation. On iOS 27: Automation stays switched on
steps.6: In the Log Transaction action, set Amount, Merchant and Card Name as below
steps.7: Amount → on iOS 27: Select Variable → Transaction → tap it → Amount. On iOS 26: Shortcut Input → tap it again → Amount
steps.8: Merchant → Transaction (iOS 26: Shortcut Input) → tap it → Merchant
steps.9: Card Name → Transaction (iOS 26: Shortcut Input) → tap it → Card or Pass
steps.10: Save: tap ‹ on iOS 27, or Done on iOS 26

guide.step3iOS26: Choose Wallet → leave every card and category selected
guide.fieldHint: Pick the purchase's own fields (the Transaction on iOS 27, Shortcut Input on iOS 26), not text from a notification, so every purchase logs the exact amount, shop and card.
guide.fieldHintFallback: If a field doesn't offer those sub-fields, tap the blue tag after choosing it: it opens Amount, Merchant and Card or Pass.
guide.doneLine: That's it — every purchase logs automatically, even with the phone locked. Make a purchase and the green banner above appears once it's verified.
